units.source_text: 源氏公子要博得紫姬的欢心，多方哄骗，也很劳倦。

en.t: Prince Genji tried every sort of coaxing and deception to win Lady Murasaki's heart, and it wore him out.

units.source_text: 他仿佛是今天新抢了一个人来，自己也觉得好笑。

en.t: It was as if he had only today carried someone off by force, and he himself found it laughable.

units.source_text: 回想已往几年间对她的爱情，真不及今天的万分之一呢。

en.t: Thinking back on the love he had felt for her over the past several years, it truly did not amount to even one ten-thousandth of what he felt today.

units.source_text: 人心真奇怪：现在教他别离一夜，也不能忍受了。

en.t: The human heart is strange indeed: now, if he were made to be apart from her for even one night, he could not bear it.
